text: ポケモンとりに　いこうって　いった　のに…コージ　どこなのよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンとりに　いこうって　いった　のに…
structure.en: even though we said 'let's go catch Pokémon'...

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに after a verb means 'even though', with a feeling of complaint that things did not turn out that way. いった のに = 'even though we said so'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut down to its short form plus に, followed by a going verb, tells what you go to do. とりに いこう = 'let's go to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: いこうって　いった
patterns.explanation: って is the casual spoken form of と, which wraps up the words that were said. いこうって いった = 'said "let's go"'.
